title: Anthropic is finding bugs faster than Microsoft can fix them
summary: One slide in that day’s presentation showed that in April alone, Mythos had uncovered 90 “critical” bugs and 141 “important” ones in SharePoint, Microsoft’s widely used collaboration software. The documents made no mention of “low”-severity bugs.
